name: DeepWiki
summary: AI-generated documentation for public GitHub repositories, with a hosted MCP server that lists a repository's topics, returns its documentation and answers questions about it. The vendor calls the MCP server free and no-authentication-required.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-08: an MCP initialize on https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp answers 200 with no credentials, server DeepWiki 2.14.3, three tools advertised. Public repositories only; private ones are a separate paid product (Devin).

jobs.summary: A free, remote MCP server that lists a public GitHub repository's documentation topics, returns its generated documentation and answers questions about it (Ask Devin).
